title: Orange and Almond Polenta Cake
blurb: A moist, grainy cake made with cornmeal and ground almonds, fragrant with orange zest and soaked in citrus syrup.
steps: Heat your oven to 180°C and butter a 23cm round cake tin, then line the base with baking paper.
Beat the softened butter and 200g sugar together until pale and fluffy, then beat in the eggs one at a time.
Fold in the cornmeal, ground almonds, baking powder and orange zest until just combined, then stir through the 60g orange juice.
Scrape the batter into the prepared tin and smooth the top, then bake for 40 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean.
While the cake bakes, make the syrup by heating the 100g orange juice and 75g sugar in a small pan until the sugar dissolves.
When the cake comes out of the oven, prick it all over with a skewer and pour the warm syrup evenly across the surface.
Leave the cake to cool completely in the tin so it absorbs all the syrup, then turn out onto a plate to serve.
